subject: [PATCH v4 16/21] hpfs: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations for the HPFS filesystem to use the new ->iomap_next() callback. This callback is generated using a macro that wraps an existing helper function, and it ensures that any previous mapping is finished before producing the next one. No functional changes are intended by this conversion.
